item.title: New update targets intimate-image exploitation and AI Deepfakes with tougher penalties - RED 89.1FM / 93.1FM Vancouver
item.description: B.C. Attorney General Nikki Sharma discusses a strengthened law to combat the spread of intimate images online, including AI-generated deepfakes. The updated legislation allows victims to quickly remove harmful content and increases penalties up to $75,000 for offenders, while ensuring privacy and support for those affected.
